records.Summary__c: Brought in by ambulance after an out-of-hospital cardiac arrest. Assessed immediately in Resus by Dr Bennett. CPR and defibrillation restored circulation after two shocks. Troponin markedly raised. Taken for coronary angioplasty and admitted to the Coronary Care Unit in a stable condition.

Walk-in with nausea, thirst and tiredness after several weeks of high-dose vitamin D supplements. Seen by Dr Bennett and handed to the nursing team for blood tests and observation. Raised calcium and vitamin D levels; given IV fluids and kept for a repeat calcium check. Discharged at 18:20 with advice to stop supplements, drink plenty of fluids and see her GP in one week.

Referred by her GP for blood tests after increasing tiredness and breathlessness. Blood results were back at 11:20 but she waited until 13:30 to be seen by Dr Rahman. Haemoglobin and ferritin low. Admitted to the Acute Medical Unit for blood transfusion and investigation of the cause of anaemia.
